cards.title: Everything that happened, in order
cards.text: 68 on-track passes, 19 pit stops, 3 cars that never finished, 1 safety car.

cards.title: 35 places changed hands on track before the first lap was done
cards.text: 18 cars into the first corner on cold tyres and full tanks.
bullets: Alonso gained the most by the end of it, 8 places
cards.note: Most of this is the pack sorting itself out. Some of it decides the race.

cards.title: 6 passes on this lap alone
cards.text: Only moves made on track count here, at racing speed.
bullets: 5 different drivers gained a place on this lap
cards.note: Early on, with full tanks and the order still settling.

cards.title: Antonelli takes the lead from Hamilton
cards.text: A pass for the lead, made on track at racing speed.

cards.title: Sainz starts P17. Where does he finish?
cards.text: 56 laps to make up ground from there.

cards.title: 19 stops, and the busiest lap saw 8 of them
cards.text: Once one car stops, the cars around it have to answer.
bullets: Busiest single lap was 10, with 8 cars in under the safety car
Shortest time in the pit lane: Hamilton, 22.4s
Longest: Ocon, 47.1s
cards.note: Pit lane time runs from the entry line to the exit line, stop included.

cards.title: Every gap on track, erased
cards.text: The field bunches up behind the safety car, and whatever anybody had built is gone.
bullets: Antonelli was leading when it came out
He took a stop under it, and so did Russell, Hamilton, Leclerc and 5 others
Neutralised until lap 13
cards.note: This early, nobody had a lead to lose. What it did do was hand a cheap stop to whoever was ready to take one.

cards.title: Yellow flags out 7 times
cards.text: Race control waves a yellow for anything on or near the track that should not be there.
bullets: A yellow means slow down and do not overtake in that part of the track
Track sector 3 saw 4 calls, more than anywhere else

cards.title: Stroll is out
cards.text: His race ends on lap 10 of 56, in an Aston Martin.
bullets: P16 at the start of lap 9
Started P20
cards.note: The timing feed records that he stopped, not why.

cards.kicker: Your call on the pit wall
cards.title: Safety car with 46 laps left. You are leading. Box or stay out?
cards.text: The pack is bunched up behind you and a stop costs far less than usual, except that everybody behind can copy you and the one who does not gets the lead.
state: Wiped out by the safety car

choices.label: Box for fresh tyres
choices.sub: Grip for the restart, hand over track position

choices.label: Stay out and defend
choices.sub: Keep the lead on older tyres

outcomes.box: New rubber under a safety car is close to free, and it only works if the cars behind stay out. If they all follow you in, you have spent your lead for nothing.
outcomes.stay: You keep the lead and restart on older tyres, with a queue of fresher cars in your mirrors and no gap to hide in.

cards.reveal: Antonelli came in. At the flag it was P1 Antonelli, P2 Russell, P3 Hamilton.

cards.title: 5 passes on this lap alone
cards.text: Only moves made on track count here, at racing speed.
bullets: 4 different drivers gained a place on this lap
cards.note: Every one of them on track, with no stops around it.

cards.title: Track at 23°C at the start, falling to 20°C at the flag
cards.text: Track temperature changes how much grip the tyres find and how fast they wear. No rain was recorded during the race.

cards.title: Ocon: 9 passes
cards.text: More than anybody else out there, in a Haas.
bullets: P13 on the grid, P14 at the flag
cards.note: Only moves made on track count, with the car ahead at racing speed.

cards.title: Gasly: 6 laps within a second of the car ahead
cards.text: The longest unbroken run like it in the race, from lap 17 to lap 22, at racing speed.
bullets: 4 other drivers had a run of five laps or more like it
cards.note: Following closely costs the car downforce and cooks the front tyres, so sitting there is harder than it looks.

cards.title: Gasly hit 353 km/h
cards.text: The fastest car in a straight line is often not the fastest car over a lap.
bullets: Gasly did it in an Alpine
cards.note: Top speed says as much about wing level, and about sitting in somebody's tow, as it does about the engine.

cards.title: Who has the fastest lap on the board at the flag?
cards.text: It usually lands late, when the car is light and the track has rubber all over it.
cards.reveal: Antonelli on lap 52, 1:35.275, in a Mercedes.

cards.title: 5 passes on this lap alone
cards.text: Only moves made on track count here, at racing speed.
bullets: 4 different drivers gained a place on this lap
cards.note: Every one of them on track, with no stops around it.

cards.kicker: Your call on the pit wall
cards.title: You are Leclerc, 0.9s behind Russell and going nowhere. Now what?
cards.text: Stuck behind another car your tyres overheat and the car will not turn. Stopping first gives you clean track for two or three laps, which is the whole trick behind the undercut.

choices.label: Box now and undercut
choices.sub: Fresh tyres, clean air, two laps to make it pay

choices.label: Stay out and overcut
choices.sub: Let him stop first, then push on an empty track

choices.label: Forget strategy, pass him
choices.sub: Send it and take the risk

outcomes.box: You spend about 23s in the lane and come out in traffic, betting that two fast laps on new tyres are worth more than the place you just gave up.
outcomes.wait: You stay on old rubber while he gets new ones, and you need clean air plus a mistake from him to make it work.
outcomes.attack: Passing a car with the same tyres on the same fuel is the hardest thing in the sport, and running into the back of him ends both races.

cards.reveal: Leclerc did not stop again. He finished P4, Russell P2.

cards.title: Alonso is out
cards.text: His race ends on lap 33 of 56, in an Aston Martin.
bullets: P17 at the start of lap 32
Started P18
1 on-track pass before it happened
cards.note: The timing feed records that he stopped, not why.

cards.title: 1 penalty handed out
cards.text: Given by the stewards during the race.
bullets: Ocon: a 10s penalty for causing a collision
cards.note: A time penalty is served at the next stop, or added to the final time when there is no stop left.

cards.title: Russell had the quickest median racing lap
cards.text: No lap 1, no laps in or out of the pits, nothing behind the safety car or the VSC, and the slow outliers trimmed. It does not always match the result.

cards.title: One of these three does not see the chequered flag. Who?
cards.text: Nothing on the timing screens says it is coming.
cards.reveal: Verstappen, on lap 46 of 56. The timing feed records that he stopped, not why.

cards.title: Verstappen is out
cards.text: His race ends on lap 46 of 56, in a Red Bull.
bullets: P6 at the start of lap 45
Started P8
8 on-track passes before it happened
cards.note: The timing feed records that he stopped, not why.

cards.title: Verstappen was P6 a lap before his race ended on lap 46. Where does he finish if it had not?
cards.text: Nobody can answer this one for certain. You have his own lap times to go on and nothing else.

choices.label: He keeps it in the points
He drops out of the points

cards.reveal: Our read from his own lap times, not a fact. He was lapping 1.29s a lap slower than Antonelli, who went on to win it. With 10 laps left, "he keeps it in the points" is the honest guess, and nobody gets to check.

cards.title: Antonelli: 1:35.275
cards.text: The quickest anybody went all race, in a Mercedes.
bullets: Set on lap 52 of 56, late on, where they usually land
By then the fuel is nearly gone and the car is at its lightest
It is worth no points: the bonus point for it was dropped after 2024

cards.title: Sainz: P17 on the grid, P9 at the flag
cards.text: 8 places gained.
bullets: 2 on-track passes along the way
1 car that started ahead of him retired

cards.title: Lawson ran one set for 47 laps
cards.text: The longest anybody stayed out on one set.
bullets: On the hards, lap 10 to lap 56
cards.note: Every lap you stretch is a lap you do not lose in the pit lane. And every lap you stretch is a set of tyres getting slower underneath you.

cards.title: 6 incidents looked at
cards.text: Every one of them logged by race control during the race.
bullets: 1 ended in a penalty and 5 in no further action

cards.title: Antonelli wins it
cards.text: P1 Antonelli · P2 Russell · P3 Hamilton.
bullets: After 56 laps, Russell crossed the line 5.515s behind

cards.title: How far behind was Russell at the flag?
cards.text: 56 laps, 1 hour 33 minutes of racing, and it comes down to this one number.
cards.reveal: 5.515 seconds after 56 laps. A trip down the pit lane took about 23s today, which is 4 times the margin this race was decided by.
